title: feat(spec)!: the page parse refuses a component data prop naming the retired view-level api source, at every door that parses a page
body:
Fixes #23357

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

> The seat amended the claim to `yes (narrowing)` at ACCEPT because of the one published export, `checkPageComponentViewData`.

## What changes

The page parse now refuses a page component's `data` prop that names the retired view-level `api` data source, as a view's own `data` is refused. That is triage's runtime half of this card (grade `6159116611`): the narrow judge for `ViewDataSchema` at a component's `data`, enforced at every door that parses a page. It is not the component-props gate's runtime rollout, which stays as decided.

- **`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`**: a fifth `PageSchema` object-level check, `checkPageComponentViewData`, attached by identifier like its four siblings. For a component of a type whose `data` is a view data source (`object-grid`, `object-map`, `object-gantt`, `object-tree`) whose `properties.data` names the retired provider, it raises the prescription `ViewDataSchema`'s own parse raises, located at the component's `properties.data.provider` (code `custom`, the code of every object-level check on this schema). The prescription is read off `ViewDataSchema`'s issue, not copied. It walks every component under `regions` and `slots` at any depth, a component nested in a `page:tabs` item or a container included.
- **`packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts`**: the stored listing's fate for such a component now says what happens: the parse refuses the page; it still loads and is served, registered under `[metadata_spec_invalid]` with the refusal in every read's `_diagnostics`; its next save is refused with 422.
- **`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.view-data-api-provider-retired.ts`**: the acceptance criteria name the page parse, at every door that parses a page, beside the component-props gate.
- `view.zod.ts`: a comment pointing from the retirement's prescription to the page check. Generated: `api-surface/ui.json`, `export-origins/ui.json` (the one new export).

**The renderer half is objectstack-ai/objectui#12325, which remains open:** until objectui deletes its reader of the retired arm, a page already stored with such a component keeps sending the request.

## Measured (mechanism hypotheses)

- **H1, half falsified.** `view.zod.ts` refuses the arm through the discriminated union's `error` map: `invalid_union` at `provider`, message `VIEW_DATA_API_PROVIDER_RETIRED`. `page.zod.ts` does NOT parse a component's `data`: `properties` is `z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())`, and on `origin/main` `PageSchema.safeParse` of an `app` page whose `object-grid` binds the retired provider answered `success: true`.
- **H2, holds.** The save door's schema is `getMetadataTypeSchema('page')`, which is `PageSchema` by identity (`resolveOverlaySchema`, `protocol.ts`). Measured through the real `saveMetaItem` in `protocol.save-union-issues.test.ts`: `422 INVALID_METADATA`, nothing persisted, issue at `regions.0.components.0.properties.data.provider`, code `custom`, the prescription. `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is untouched.
- **H3, the four, and only by declaration.** Derived from `ComponentPropsMap` by def identity, the rows whose `data` member is `ViewDataSchema` are exactly `object-grid`, `object-map`, `object-gantt`, `object-tree` (59 rows; `object-kanban`, `object-calendar`, `object-timeline` take a row array). The page check cannot derive that set itself: `component.zod.ts` imports `page.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src` has zero import cycles (measured: 1383 modules, 0 strongly connected components), and moving `ElementDataSourceSchema` / `RETIRED_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` out of `page.zod.ts` would change the published skill's generated references. So the set is declared in `page.zod.ts` (the `PRINT_REFUSED_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` precedent) and pinned equal to the derivation in both directions (`page-component-view-data.test.ts`: for every props row, the page parse refuses the binding exactly when the row's `data` is `ViewDataSchema`). The same cycle keeps `pageComponentSlotPositions()` out of reach, so the walk descends every object under `regions` and `slots`, a superset of every slot position: it reaches no less than `os migrate meta --stored` lists or the props gate judges, and what it judges at a node stays the one retired binding on those four types.
- **H4, stored pages load and are listed; their next save is refused.** Boot hydration (`loadMetaFromDb`, measured with a throwaway probe over a stub engine, not committed): two stored pages, one bound to the retired provider: `{"loaded":2,"errors":0,"invalid":1}`, both registered, one `[metadata_spec_invalid]` warning naming `page/partner_page` and the prescription. Read path (`getMetaItem`, pinned): served, with `_diagnostics.valid: false` and the prescription at the component's position. The fate text states exactly that.

## Tests

Every run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. Final verdicts are at `63e1e4800`, the branch merged with `origin/main` `c857a93ee`. The newest head, `dce543307`, adds only the changeset's `Clause-②` line.

- `@objectstack/spec`, `vitest run --project local`: 675 files, 20507 passed, 1 todo, exit 0.
- `@objectstack/spec`, `--project repo`: 59 files, 1011 passed, exit 0. This project holds the tree-scoped absence pin.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: 235 files passed, 3 skipped; 28377 tests passed, exit 0.
- `@objectstack/cli`, `--project unit`: 287 files, 4307 tests passed, exit 0.
- `@objectstack/lint`: 138 files, 6699 tests passed, exit 0, at `7309ef08c`. The later merge touched nothing in `packages/lint`.
- `typecheck` of spec and of metadata-protocol: exit 0 each.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date.

New pins:
- `packages/spec/src/ui/page-component-view-data.test.ts`:
  - each of the four types is refused at `regions.0.components.0.properties.data.provider` with the retirement's exact message;
  - a nested component, a container's grandchild and a slot are each refused at their own position;
  - `definePage`, `getMetadataTypeSchema('page')` and the stack parse all refuse;
  - controls: `object`, `value`, `schema`, no `data`, another provider, `object-kanban`, a custom type and the element `dataSource` binding are accepted;
  - a derivation pin over all 59 `ComponentPropsMap` rows.
- `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts`: the fifth export's parity, count, attachment and barrel legs.
- `refused-shapes.test.ts`: the new fate text, and the page parse refuses exactly the positions the listing lists.
- `protocol.save-union-issues.test.ts`:
  - `422 INVALID_METADATA` with nothing persisted, top-level and nested;
  - control saves with `object` and `value` (one row each);
  - the read path serves a stored page with `_diagnostics.valid: false` and the prescription.

Not run locally, and declared to CI:
- the cli integration layer: the diff touches no integration file and no spawn entry;
- the full `turbo ls --affected` closure, 83 packages. That set comes from the package dependency graph and is blind to tests that read another package's source from disk. The root package's own suites are not on the graph.

## Ablation (negative control)

Run on `7309ef08c` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which mutates and restores and proves both on disk, and `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`.

1. **Pristine.** The dist marker `superRefine(checkPageComponentViewData))` is present in 18 built JS files, and the tree is clean.
2. **Mutate.** The attachment `.superRefine(checkPageComponentViewData));` is replaced by an inert comment. The anchor count goes 1 to 0, and the blob goes `ed11df9efb60` to `b310419cea20`.
   - The spec source suites go red: 3 files, 17 failed, 268 passed. They are the four type pins, nested/slot, doors, self-reference, the derivation pin, the export parity/count/attachment legs, and the two refused-shapes parity pins.
   - After the spec rebuild, the preflight reads the marker absent from all 232 built files.
   - `protocol.save-union-issues.test.ts` goes red: 3 failed, 26 passed. They are the two 422 pins and the read path. The control save stays green.
3. **Restore.** The blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` is empty and the whole-tree status is clean. After the spec rebuild, the marker is present in 18 files and the tree is clean. Spec runs 285/285 and metadata-protocol 29/29.

The expected direction: the pins turn red.

Two earlier attempts carry no reading:
- The first was a no-op. The tool refused it because the replacement `);` already occurred in the file, so the mutation never landed.
- The second used a dist marker that the `.d.ts` docblock also carries, so its dist reading was void. It was re-run as above, with a marker only the runtime JS carries.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` on `7309ef08c` reports 90 derived families, all accounted for. 88 exited 0, including `check:adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check:api-surface`, `check:generated` (all 14 artifacts up to date), `check:skill-refs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:cross-package-test-inputs`.

NOT MEASURED:
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET. 9 packages outside this card's build closure have no `dist/`.
- `check:type-check-debt`: its re-measure re-runs `tsc` over every DEBT-ledger package repo-wide, which CI owns. The touched packages' own `typecheck` runs are green.

Repo-wide `pnpm lint` was not run locally. CI owns it.

## Acceptance notes

- One published export added (`checkPageComponentViewData`), required by `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` for every object-level `PageSchema` check so a `.shape` mirror can re-attach it; see the `Clause-②` note at the top.
- The page check's issue code is `custom`, not the view's `invalid_union`: the object-level-check pin reads `custom` as the code of every check on the schema. The message is the retirement's, byte for byte.
- ADR-0087: `not-required (already-registered view-data-api-provider-retired)`; `check-adr-0087-registration` accepts it.
- Consumer sweep: `examples/**` holds no `provider: 'api'` (0 hits; control `provider: 'object'` hits in `examples/app-crm/src/views`); the tree-scoped absence pin (`view-data-api-provider-retirement.test.ts`) is green, and every fixture here spells the provider through a constant.
